    11	/-!
    12	# A relative Koszul boundary for high-window relations
    13	
    14	Multiplication by the fixed basis of the `S`-window carries a submodule in
    15	high window `n` toward high window `n + 1`.  Given a target submodule which
    16	contains these products, this file corestricts each basis multiplication to
    17	a step between the two submodules and forms the finite rows-minus-columns
    18	Koszul boundary.
    19	
    20	The next high-window multiplication map kills this boundary.  This is the
    21	relative `range <= kernel` half of the finite-stage relation theorem; the
    22	reverse inclusion on residue-field fibres is the geometric pencil input.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	set_option quotPrecheck false
    27	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    28	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 8
    29	set_option maxRecDepth 8000

    45	section HighWindowRelativeKoszul
    46	
    47	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    48	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    49	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    50	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi] [IsDominant pi]
    51	
    52	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftHighWindowRelativeKoszul :
    53	    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    54	
    55	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
    56	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    57	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    58	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
    59	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
    60	variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    61	variable (g r1 r2 : Nat)
    62	variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
    63	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
    64	variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
    65	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k ((windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    66	    + (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)) ⊤))
    67	variable (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
    68	
    69	local notation "RZ" => DivCarveChartRing k
    70	  (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    71	  (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j
    72	local notation "HS" => ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
    73	  (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤)
    74	local notation "HI" => Fin (Module.finrank k HS)
    75	
    76	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
    77	-- The dependent source and successor submodules are expensive to elaborate.
    78	/-- The basis multiplications from `K` land in the chosen successor
    79	submodule `Knext`.  Keeping this as a hypothesis also covers the exceptional
    80	seed transition, whose target is not definitionally the recursive range. -/
    81	def DivUniversalHighWindowMulPreserves (n : Nat)
    82	    (K : Submodule RZ
    83	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
    84	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
    85	    (Knext : Submodule RZ
    86	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
    87	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1))) :
    88	    Prop :=
    89	  ∀ (t : HI) (z : K),
    90	    divUniversalHighWindowBaseMultiplierTransition (C := C) (pi := pi)
    91	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n ((Module.finBasis k HS) t)
    92	        (K.subtype z) ∈ Knext
    93	
    94	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
    95	-- The supported source vector unfolds the dependent multiplication map.
    96	/-- The canonical multiplication-span successor satisfies the preservation
    97	condition by taking a vector supported at the chosen basis index. -/
    98	theorem divUniversalHighWindowMulPreserves_mulSpan (n : Nat)
    99	    (K : Submodule RZ
   100	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   101	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n)) :
   102	    DivUniversalHighWindowMulPreserves (C := C) (pi := pi)
   103	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K
   104	      (divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan (C := C) (pi := pi)
   105	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K) := by
   106	  intro t z
   107	  exact divUniversalHighWindowBaseMultiplierTransition_finBasis_mem_mulSpan
   108	    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K t
   109	      (K.subtype z) z.property
   110	
   111	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   112	-- Corestricting traverses both dependent high-window ambient types.
   113	/-- Multiplication by one `S`-window basis vector, corestricted from `K` to
   114	a successor submodule known to contain all such products. -/
   115	noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowBasisStep (n : Nat)
   116	    (K : Submodule RZ
   117	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   118	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
   119	    (Knext : Submodule RZ
   120	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   121	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1)))
   122	    (hpres : DivUniversalHighWindowMulPreserves (C := C) (pi := pi)
   123	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext) (t : HI) : K →ₗ[RZ] Knext :=
   124	  ((divUniversalHighWindowBaseMultiplierTransition (C := C) (pi := pi)
   125	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n ((Module.finBasis k HS) t)).comp
   126	    K.subtype).codRestrict Knext (hpres t)
   127	
   128	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   129	-- Reducing the dependent corestriction needs the larger elaboration budget.
   130	@[simp]
   131	theorem coe_divUniversalHighWindowBasisStep (n : Nat)
   132	    (K : Submodule RZ
   133	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   134	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
   135	    (Knext : Submodule RZ
   136	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   137	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1)))
   138	    (hpres : DivUniversalHighWindowMulPreserves (C := C) (pi := pi)
   139	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext) (t : HI) (z : K) :
   140	    ((divUniversalHighWindowBasisStep (C := C) (pi := pi)
   141	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext hpres t z : Knext) :
   142	      divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   143	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2)
   144	        (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1)) =
   145	      divUniversalHighWindowBaseMultiplierTransition (C := C) (pi := pi)
   146	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n ((Module.finBasis k HS) t) (K.subtype z) :=
   147	  rfl
   148	
   149	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   150	-- The finite function modules retain both dependent relation subtypes.
   151	/-- The relative finite Koszul boundary between consecutive high-window
   152	submodules. -/
   153	noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowKoszulBoundary (n : Nat)
   154	    (K : Submodule RZ
   155	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   156	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
   157	    (Knext : Submodule RZ
   158	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   159	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1)))
   160	    (hpres : DivUniversalHighWindowMulPreserves (C := C) (pi := pi)
   161	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext) :
   162	    (HI × HI → K) →ₗ[RZ] (HI → Knext) :=
   163	  finiteKoszulBoundary (fun t =>
   164	    divUniversalHighWindowBasisStep (C := C) (pi := pi)
   165	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext hpres t)
   166	
   167	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   168	-- Naming the dependent step family avoids re-elaborating both relation subtypes.
   169	/-- The relative boundary is the generic finite Koszul boundary on its
   170	basis-indexed multiplication steps. -/
   171	theorem divUniversalHighWindowKoszulBoundary_eq_finite (n : Nat)
   172	    (K : Submodule RZ
   173	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   174	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
   175	    (Knext : Submodule RZ
   176	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   177	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1)))
   178	    (hpres : DivUniversalHighWindowMulPreserves (C := C) (pi := pi)
   179	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext) :
   180	    divUniversalHighWindowKoszulBoundary (C := C) (pi := pi)
   181	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext hpres =
   182	      finiteKoszulBoundary (fun t =>
   183	        divUniversalHighWindowBasisStep (C := C) (pi := pi)
   184	          hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext hpres t) :=
   185	  rfl
   186	
   187	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   188	-- The row type contains the dependent ambient and relation subtype at one stage.
   189	/-- One component row of the high-window multiplication map. -/
   190	noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowMulRow (n : Nat)
   191	    (K : Submodule RZ
   192	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   193	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
   194	    (t : HI) : K →ₗ[RZ]
   195	      divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   196	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2)
   197	        (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1) :=
   198	  (LinearMap.baseChange RZ
   199	    (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n
   200	      ((Module.finBasis k HS) t))).comp K.subtype
   201	
   202	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   203	-- Associating the dependent inclusion with each finite projection is expensive.
   204	/-- The high-window multiplication map is the finite sum of its component rows. -/
   205	theorem divUniversalHighWindowMulMap_eq_finiteComponentSum (n : Nat)
   206	    (K : Submodule RZ
   207	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   208	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n)) :
   209	    divUniversalHighWindowMulMap (C := C) (pi := pi)
   210	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K =
   211	      finiteComponentSum (divUniversalHighWindowMulRow (C := C) (pi := pi)
   212	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K) := by
   213	  classical
   214	  simp only [divUniversalHighWindowMulMap, finiteComponentSum,
   215	    divUniversalHighWindowMulRow, LinearMap.comp_assoc]
   216	
   217	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   218	-- Expanding both dependent successor reindexings is elaboration-heavy.
   219	/-- Consecutive high-window basis multiplications commute over the base
   220	field. -/
   221	theorem divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul_comp_comm (n : Nat) (a b : HS) :
   222	    (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g (n + 1) a).comp
   223	        (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n b) =
   224	      (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g (n + 1) b).comp
   225	  (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n a) := by
   226	  ext z
   227	  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, coe_divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul]
   228	  ring
   229	
   230	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   231	-- Base change traverses two consecutive dependent high-window maps.
   232	/-- Consecutive high-window basis multiplications still commute after scalar
   233	extension to the carve-chart ring. -/
   234	theorem divUniversalHighWindowBaseChangeShiftMul_comm (n : Nat) (a b : HS)
   235	    (z : divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   236	      (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n) :
   237	    LinearMap.baseChange RZ
   238	        (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g (n + 1) a)
   239	        (LinearMap.baseChange RZ
   240	          (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n b) z) =
   241	      LinearMap.baseChange RZ
   242	        (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g (n + 1) b)
   243	        (LinearMap.baseChange RZ
   244	          (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n a) z) := by
   245	  change
   246	    ((LinearMap.baseChange RZ
   247	      (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g (n + 1) a)).comp
   248	        (LinearMap.baseChange RZ
   249	          (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n b))) z = _
   250	  rw [← LinearMap.baseChange_comp,
   251	    divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul_comp_comm (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n a b,
   252	    LinearMap.baseChange_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply]
   253	
   254	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   255	-- The generic cancellation lemma is instantiated with two dependent relation stages.
   256	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
   257	-- The congruence map synthesizes the dependent carve-ring linear-map module.
   258	/-- The finite component sum of the successor rows kills the relative Koszul
   259	boundary. -/
   260	theorem finiteComponentSum_divUniversalHighWindowMulRow_comp_koszulBoundary_eq_zero
   261	    (n : Nat)
   262	    (K : Submodule RZ
   263	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   264	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
   265	    (Knext : Submodule RZ
   266	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   267	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1)))
   268	    (hpres : DivUniversalHighWindowMulPreserves (C := C) (pi := pi)
   269	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext) :
   270	    (finiteComponentSum
   271	        (divUniversalHighWindowMulRow (C := C) (pi := pi)
   272	          hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1) Knext)).comp
   273	      (divUniversalHighWindowKoszulBoundary (C := C) (pi := pi)
   274	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext hpres) = 0 := by
   275	  let step : HI → K →ₗ[RZ] Knext := fun t =>
   276	    divUniversalHighWindowBasisStep (C := C) (pi := pi)
   277	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext hpres t
   278	  have hzero := finiteComponentSum_comp_finiteKoszulBoundary_eq_zero
   279	    (divUniversalHighWindowMulRow (C := C) (pi := pi)
   280	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1) Knext) step (by
   281	        intro a b z
   282	        change
   283	          LinearMap.baseChange RZ
   284	              (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g (n + 1)
   285	                ((Module.finBasis k HS) a))
   286	              (LinearMap.baseChange RZ
   287	                (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n
   288	                  ((Module.finBasis k HS) b)) (K.subtype z)) =
   289	            LinearMap.baseChange RZ
   290	              (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g (n + 1)
   291	                ((Module.finBasis k HS) b))
   292	              (LinearMap.baseChange RZ
   293	                (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n
   294	                  ((Module.finBasis k HS) a)) (K.subtype z))
   295	        exact divUniversalHighWindowBaseChangeShiftMul_comm
   296	          (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n
   297	            ((Module.finBasis k HS) a) ((Module.finBasis k HS) b) (K.subtype z))
   298	  have hboundary := divUniversalHighWindowKoszulBoundary_eq_finite
   299	    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext hpres
   300	  exact (congrArg (fun d =>
   301	    (finiteComponentSum
   302	      (divUniversalHighWindowMulRow (C := C) (pi := pi)
   303	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1) Knext)).comp d) hboundary).trans hzero
   304	
   305	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   306	-- The dependent stages and their two consecutive multiplication maps are large.
   307	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
   308	-- The final composition congruence uses the dependent boundary map module.
   309	/-- The multiplication map out of `Knext` kills the relative Koszul boundary
   310	formed one stage earlier. -/
   311	theorem divUniversalHighWindowMulMap_comp_koszulBoundary_eq_zero (n : Nat)
   312	    (K : Submodule RZ
   313	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   314	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
   315	    (Knext : Submodule RZ
   316	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   317	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1)))
   318	    (hpres : DivUniversalHighWindowMulPreserves (C := C) (pi := pi)
   319	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext) :
   320	    (divUniversalHighWindowMulMap (C := C) (pi := pi)
   321	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1) Knext).comp
   322	      (divUniversalHighWindowKoszulBoundary (C := C) (pi := pi)
   323	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext hpres) = 0 := by
   324	  have hmul := divUniversalHighWindowMulMap_eq_finiteComponentSum
   325	    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1) Knext
   326	  have hzero :=
   327	    finiteComponentSum_divUniversalHighWindowMulRow_comp_koszulBoundary_eq_zero
   328	      (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext hpres
   329	  exact (congrArg (fun f => f.comp
   330	    (divUniversalHighWindowKoszulBoundary (C := C) (pi := pi)
   331	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K Knext hpres)) hmul).trans hzero

    11	/-!
    12	# Residue-field normalization of the universal high-window ambients
    13	
    14	At a field-valued point of a carve chart, cancelling the two-step scalar
    15	extension identifies the relative high-window ambient with the scalar-extended
    16	base-field window.  The `divFamPhi` dictionary then identifies that window with
    17	the transported divisor-section space.
    18	
    19	This file records the comparison uniformly at every exponent `M + n*S`.  It
    20	also translates a successor window to the literal sum of the multiplier and
    21	predecessor transported divisors.  The translation is valid after subtracting
    22	an arbitrary divisor, and the resulting normalized successor read commutes
    23	with multiplication.
    24	-/

   228	/-- Multiplication by the arbitrary-exponent coherence unit as an equivalence
   229	of divisor-section spaces.  The auxiliary subtracted divisor is unrestricted. -/
   230	noncomputable def windowAddCoherenceDivisorEquiv (p q : Nat)
   231	    (D : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor) :
   232	    ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K
   233	        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi (p + q) - D) ⊤) ≃ₗ[K]
   234	      ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K
   235	        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi p +
   236	          windowTransportDivisor C K pi q - D) ⊤) := by
   237	  let source := Scheme.divisorSections K
   238	    (windowTransportDivisor C K pi (p + q) - D) ⊤
   239	  let target := Scheme.divisorSections K
   240	    (windowTransportDivisor C K pi p +
   241	      windowTransportDivisor C K pi q - D) ⊤
   242	  let mul := Scheme.mulLinear K
   243	    ((windowAddCoherenceUnit (pi := pi) C K p q :
   244	      (relCurve C K).functionFieldˣ) : (relCurve C K).functionField)
   245	  let f := (mul.comp source.subtype).codRestrict target (fun x => by
   246	    have hx : mul x ∈ Submodule.map mul source :=
   247	      Submodule.mem_map_of_mem x.property
   248	    rw [map_mulLinear_windowAddCoherenceUnit (pi := pi) C K p q D] at hx
   249	    exact hx)
   250	  refine LinearEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   251	  · intro x y hxy
   252	    apply Subtype.ext
   253	    apply mul_left_cancel₀
   254	      (Units.ne_zero (windowAddCoherenceUnit (pi := pi) C K p q))
   255	    exact congrArg Subtype.val hxy
   256	  · intro y
   257	    have hy : (y : (relCurve C K).functionField) ∈ Submodule.map mul source := by
   258	      rw [map_mulLinear_windowAddCoherenceUnit (pi := pi) C K p q D]
   259	      exact y.property
   260	    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hy
   261	    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Subtype.ext hxy⟩
   262	
   263	@[simp]
   264	theorem windowAddCoherenceDivisorEquiv_apply (p q : Nat)
   265	    (D : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor)
   266	    (x : ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K
   267	      (windowTransportDivisor C K pi (p + q) - D) ⊤)) :
   268	    (windowAddCoherenceDivisorEquiv (pi := pi) C K p q D x :
   269	        (relCurve C K).functionField) =
   270	      ((windowAddCoherenceUnit (pi := pi) C K p q :
   271	        (relCurve C K).functionFieldˣ) : (relCurve C K).functionField) * x :=
   272	  rfl

   274	/-- The top-window specialization used to normalize a successor ambient. -/
   275	noncomputable def windowAddCoherenceTopEquiv (p q : Nat) :

   286	
   287	/-- The closed coherence unit comparing the transported window at `M+n*S`
   288	with the literal divisor `N+n*S`. -/
   289	noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowClosedCoherenceUnit (n : Nat) :
   290	    (relCurve C K).functionFieldˣ :=
   291	  thetaFieldShiftUnit C K pi (windowM_choice pi hpi g) *
   292	    thetaFieldShiftUnit C K pi (windowS_choice pi hpi g) ^ n *
   293	      (thetaFieldShiftUnit C K pi exp[n])⁻¹
   294	
   295	/-- The closed units satisfy the successor recurrence through the binary
   296	coherence unit. -/
   297	theorem divUniversalHighWindowClosedCoherenceUnit_succ (n : Nat) :
   298	    divUniversalHighWindowClosedCoherenceUnit
   299	        (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g K (n + 1) =
   300	      divUniversalHighWindowClosedCoherenceUnit
   301	          (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g K n *
   302	        windowAddCoherenceUnit (pi := pi) C K
   303	          (windowS_choice pi hpi g) exp[n] := by
   304	  rw [divUniversalHighWindowClosedCoherenceUnit,
   305	    divUniversalHighWindowClosedCoherenceUnit, windowAddCoherenceUnit,
   306	    pow_succ]
   307	  simp only [divUniversalHighWindowExponent]
   308	  have hexp : windowM_choice pi hpi g + (n + 1) * windowS_choice pi hpi g =
   309	      windowS_choice pi hpi g +
   310	        (windowM_choice pi hpi g + n * windowS_choice pi hpi g) := by
   311	    rw [Nat.succ_mul]
   312	    omega
   313	  rw [hexp]
   314	  let uM := thetaFieldShiftUnit C K pi (windowM_choice pi hpi g)
   315	  let uS := thetaFieldShiftUnit C K pi (windowS_choice pi hpi g)
   316	  let un := thetaFieldShiftUnit C K pi
   317	    (windowM_choice pi hpi g + n * windowS_choice pi hpi g)
   318	  let un1 := thetaFieldShiftUnit C K pi
   319	    (windowS_choice pi hpi g +
   320	      (windowM_choice pi hpi g + n * windowS_choice pi hpi g))
   321	  change uM * (uS ^ n * uS) * un1⁻¹ =
   322	    uM * uS ^ n * un⁻¹ * (uS * un * un1⁻¹)
   323	  calc
   324	    _ = uM * uS ^ n * uS * (un⁻¹ * un) * un1⁻¹ := by
   325	      rw [inv_mul_cancel, mul_one]
   326	      ac_rfl
   327	    _ = _ := by ac_rfl

   329	/-- At stage one, the closed unit is the seed `(M,S)` coherence unit. -/

   332	        (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g K 1 =

   334	  rw [divUniversalHighWindowClosedCoherenceUnit, msCoherenceUnit]

   336	  rw [mul_comm (thetaFieldShiftUnit C K pi (windowM_choice pi hpi g))

   340	/-- The divisor of the closed unit is precisely the discrepancy between the
   341	transported exponent window and `N+n*S`. -/
   342	theorem divOf_divUniversalHighWindowClosedCoherenceUnit (n : Nat) :
   343	    windowTransportDivisor C K pi exp[n] -
   344	        (windowN C K hpi g + n • windowS C K hpi g) =
   345	      Scheme.divOf (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
   346	        (divUniversalHighWindowClosedCoherenceUnit
   347	          (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g K n) := by
   348	  induction n with
   349	  | zero =>
   350	      rw [divUniversalHighWindowClosedCoherenceUnit]
   351	      simp only [divUniversalHighWindowExponent, zero_mul, add_zero,
   352	        zero_nsmul, pow_zero, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel, Scheme.divOf_one,
   353	        show windowTransportDivisor C K pi (windowM_choice pi hpi g) =
   354	          windowN C K hpi g from rfl]
   355	      exact sub_self _
   356	  | succ n ih =>
   357	      rw [divUniversalHighWindowClosedCoherenceUnit_succ,
   358	        Scheme.divOf_mul, ← ih,
   359	        ← divOf_windowAddCoherenceUnit (pi := pi) C K
   360	          (windowS_choice pi hpi g) exp[n],
   361	        divUniversalHighWindowExponent_succ
   362	          (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n]
   363	      change windowTransportDivisor C K pi exp[n + 1] -
   364	          (windowN C K hpi g + (n + 1) • windowS C K hpi g) =
   365	        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi exp[n] -
   366	          (windowN C K hpi g + n • windowS C K hpi g)) +
   367	        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi exp[n + 1] -
   368	          (windowS C K hpi g + windowTransportDivisor C K pi exp[n]))
   369	      rw [succ_nsmul]
   370	      abel

    39	/-- Kernel containment transfers through equivalences conjugating a pair of maps
    40	and their base changes.  The equivalences need not arise from tensor products;
    41	the statement only uses their bijectivity and the two displayed naturality laws.
    42	
    43	`hf` conjugates `baseChange S f` to `f'`, while `hd` conjugates `baseChange S d`
    44	to `d'`.  Thus a witness in the fibre range can be pulled back through the
    45	source equivalence and gives a witness in the relative base-change range.
    46	-/
    47	theorem ker_baseChange_le_range_baseChange_of_conjugate
    48	    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (d : P →ₗ[R] M)
    49	    (f' : M' →ₗ[S] N') (d' : P' →ₗ[S] M')
    50	    (eM : (S ⊗[R] M) ≃ₗ[S] M')
    51	    (eN : (S ⊗[R] N) →ₗ[S] N')
    52	    (eP : (S ⊗[R] P) ≃ₗ[S] P')
    53	    (hf : ∀ x : S ⊗[R] M,
    54	      eN (LinearMap.baseChange S f x) = f' (eM x))
    55	    (hd : ∀ y : S ⊗[R] P,
    56	      eM (LinearMap.baseChange S d y) = d' (eP y))
    57	    (hker : LinearMap.ker f' ≤ LinearMap.range d') :
    58	    LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.baseChange S f) ≤
    59	      LinearMap.range (LinearMap.baseChange S d) := by
    60	  intro x hx
    61	  have hfx' : f' (eM x) = 0 := by
    62	    rw [← hf x, LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hx, map_zero]
    63	  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hker (LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hfx')
    64	  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := eP.surjective z
    65	  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    66	  apply eM.injective
    67	  rw [hd y, hz]

    78	    (eN : (S ⊗[R] N) →ₗ[S] N')
    79	    (eP : (S ⊗[R] P) ≃ₗ[S] P')
    80	    (hf : ∀ x : S ⊗[R] M,

   157	    ((divUniversalHighWindowRelationFibreEquiv
   158	        C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K hO hchi hker n himage x :
   159	      divUniversalFibreHighWindow
   160	        C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K hO hchi hker n) :
   161	      (relCurve C K).functionField) =
   162	    ((divUniversalHighWindowClosedAmbientFibreEquiv

    10	/-!
    11	# Shifted high-window transition read formulas
    12	
    13	The transition relation records the arbitrary-side chart-reading formula, so
    14	its iterates multiply each chart reading by a fixed unit-section reading.  The
    15	unit-read calculations are kept here; the eventual theta-kernel argument lives
    16	in the companion `DivSchemeHighWindowTransitionKernelKill` module.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	set_option quotPrecheck false
    21	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

    39	section HighWindowTransitionKernel
    40	
    41	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    42	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    43	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    44	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi] [IsDominant pi]
    45	
    46	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftHighWindowTransitionKernel :
    47	    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    48	
    49	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
    50	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    51	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    52	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
    53	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
    54	variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    55	variable (g r1 r2 : Nat)
    56	variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
    57	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
    58	variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
    59	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k ((windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    60	    + (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)) ⊤))
    61	variable (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
    62	
    63	local notation "RZ" => DivCarveChartRing k
    64	  (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    65	  (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j
    66	local notation "G" n => divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi)
    67	  (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2)
    68	  (i := i) (j := j) n
    69	local notation "CR" => divUniversalHighWindowChartRead (C := C)
    70	  (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j
    71	
    72	/-! ## The fixed multiplier read -/
    73	
    74	/-- The reading of the canonical multiplier used by a side-preserving transition. -/
    75	noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowUnitRead
    76	    (transitionSide readSide : Bool) :
    77	    Γ(relCurve C RZ, relPinnedChart C RZ pi readSide) :=
    78	  relThetaResSide (windowS_choice pi hpi g) readSide le_rfl
    79	    (relThetaSideUnitSection C RZ pi transitionSide
    80	      (windowS_choice pi hpi g))
    81	
    82	/-! ## One-step and iterated chart readings -/
    83	
    84	set_option maxHeartbeats 4800000 in
    85	-- The arbitrary-side transition formula unfolds the dependent theta dictionary.
    86	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 1200000 in
    87	/-- A side-preserving one-step transition multiplies every chart reading by the
    88	reading of its canonical multiplier. -/
    89	theorem divUniversalHighWindowRelationTransition_chartRead_mul
    90	    (transitionSide readSide : Bool) (n : Nat) (x : G(n + 1)) :
    91	    (CR (n + 2) readSide)
    92	        (divUniversalHighWindowRelationTransition (C := C) (pi := pi)
    93	          hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j transitionSide (n + 1) x) =
    94	      divUniversalHighWindowUnitRead (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j
    95	          transitionSide readSide * (CR (n + 1) readSide) x := by
    96	  rw [divUniversalHighWindowRelationTransition,
    97	    divUniversalHighWindowTensorMultiplierTransition_chartRead,
    98	    divUniversalHighWindowSideMultiplierTensor_theta]
    99	  rfl
   100	
   101	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   102	-- The induction repeatedly re-elaborates the shifted dependent ambient.
   103	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 1200000 in
   104	-- Each induction branch synthesizes the module structure of a shifted stage family.
   105	/-- Iterated shifted transitions multiply an arbitrary chart reading by a power
   106	of the fixed canonical multiplier reading. -/
   107	theorem divUniversalHighWindowShiftedRelationTransitionOfLE_chartRead_pow
   108	    (transitionSide readSide : Bool) (n m : Nat) (h : n ≤ m) (x : G(n + 1)) :
   109	    (CR (m + 1) readSide)
   110	        (divUniversalHighWindowShiftedRelationTransitionOfLE (C := C) (pi := pi)
   111	          hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j transitionSide n m h x) =
   112	      (divUniversalHighWindowUnitRead (C := C) (pi := pi)
   113	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j transitionSide readSide) ^ (m - n) *
   114	        (CR (n + 1) readSide) x := by
   115	  induction h with
   116	  | refl =>
   117	      simp [divUniversalHighWindowShiftedRelationTransitionOfLE,
   118	        HighWindowTransitionKit.transitionOfLE_self]
   119	  | @step m h ih =>
   120	      rw [divUniversalHighWindowShiftedRelationTransitionOfLE,
   121	        HighWindowTransitionKit.transitionOfLE_succ
   122	          (fun q => G(q + 1))
   123	          (fun q => divUniversalHighWindowRelationTransition
   124	            (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j transitionSide (q + 1))
   125	          n m h,
   126	        LinearMap.comp_apply,
   127	        divUniversalHighWindowRelationTransition_chartRead_mul]
   128	      have ih' :
   129	          (CR (m + 1) readSide)
   130	              (HighWindowTransitionKit.transitionOfLE
   131	                (fun q => G (q + 1))
   132	                (fun q => divUniversalHighWindowRelationTransition
   133	                  (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j
   134	                  transitionSide (q + 1)) n m h x) =
   135	            (divUniversalHighWindowUnitRead (C := C) (pi := pi)
   136	              hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j transitionSide readSide) ^ (m - n) *
   137	              (CR (n + 1) readSide) x := by
   138	        simpa only [divUniversalHighWindowShiftedRelationTransitionOfLE] using ih
   139	      rw [ih']
   140	      have hsub : m + 1 - n = (m - n) + 1 := Nat.sub_add_comm h
   141	      rw [hsub, pow_succ]
   142	      ring
   143	
   144	/-! ## Unit-read powers -/
   145	
   146	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   147	-- The four side combinations unfold dependent relative-chart section rings.
   148	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   149	-- Same-side unit reads and opposite coordinate powers use different chart presentations.
   150	/-- The opposite pinned-chart reading of a `q*S` side unit is the `q`-th power
   151	of the one-step opposite reading. -/
   152	theorem divUniversalHighWindowUnitRead_pow
   153	    (transitionSide readSide : Bool) (q : Nat) :
   154	    (divUniversalHighWindowUnitRead (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j
   155	      transitionSide readSide) ^ q =
   156	      relThetaResSide (q * windowS_choice pi hpi g) readSide le_rfl
   157	        (relThetaSideUnitSection C RZ pi transitionSide
   158	          (q * windowS_choice pi hpi g)) := by
   159	  unfold divUniversalHighWindowUnitRead
   160	  cases transitionSide with
   161	  | false =>
   162	      cases readSide with
   163	      | false =>
   164	          rw [relThetaResSide_relThetaSideUnit,
   165	            relThetaResSide_relThetaSideUnit, one_pow]
   166	      | true =>
   167	          rw [relThetaResSide_relThetaSideUnit_false_true,
   168	            relThetaResSide_relThetaSideUnit_false_true]
   169	          simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using
   170	            (pow_mul (relFiberCoord₁ C RZ pi)
   171	              (windowS_choice pi hpi g) q).symm
   172	  | true =>
   173	      cases readSide with
   174	      | false =>
   175	          rw [relThetaResSide_relThetaSideUnit_true_false,
   176	            relThetaResSide_relThetaSideUnit_true_false]
   177	          simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using
   178	            (pow_mul (relFiberCoord₀ C RZ pi)
   179	              (windowS_choice pi hpi g) q).symm
   180	      | true =>
   181	          rw [relThetaResSide_relThetaSideUnit,
   182	            relThetaResSide_relThetaSideUnit, one_pow]
   183	
   184	end HighWindowTransitionKernel
   185	
   186	end AlgebraicGeometry

   203	  · intro i j z
   204	    change
   205	      (b i : X.functionField) * ((b j : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField)) =
   206	        (b j : X.functionField) * ((b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField))
   207	    ring
   208	  · intro x
   209	    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hspan x
   210	    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
   211	    apply Subtype.ext
   212	    simp only [step, c, Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul,
   213	      Scheme.finiteMulStepTo_apply]

   215	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   216	    intro q hq
   217	    exact (Scheme.sum_repr_mul U b (a q) (z q : X.functionField)).symm

   225	        (Scheme.sum_repr_mul U b (a q) (y q : X.functionField)).symm

   227	    refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_⟩

     9	/-!
    10	# Exact multiplication relations in every high window
    11	
    12	This file assembles the field-level high-window theorem.  For
    13	
    14	`B_n = N + nS - D`, `A_n = N + (n+1)S - D`,
    15	
    16	the canonical finite Koszul boundary from `B_n` presents the complete kernel
    17	of the multiplication map into `A_n`, provided `H^0(O(S))` contains a
    18	basepoint-free pair and the `P-fib` descent budget holds.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	
    23	universe u v
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	open Scheme

    31	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.functionFieldOverModule
    32	
    33	variable {K : Type u} [Field K]
    34	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    35	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
    36	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    37	  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    38	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
    39	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
    40	variable {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]
    41	
    42	omit [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    43	  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    44	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
    45	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 1)] in
    46	/-- Multiplication by a section of `S` sends the `n`-th divisor window into
    47	the next one. -/
    48	theorem Scheme.mul_mem_divisorSections_highWindow
    49	    (N S D : X.CurveDivisor) (n : ℕ)
    50	    (a : divisorSections K S ⊤) (z : divisorSections K (N + n • S - D) ⊤) :
    51	    (a : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈
    52	      divisorSections K (N + (n + 1) • S - D) ⊤ := by
    53	  have hmul := mul_mem_divisorSections_top K a.property z.property
    54	  convert hmul using 1
    55	  rw [add_nsmul, one_nsmul]
    56	  abel_nf
    57	
    58	/-- The canonical finite Koszul boundary between consecutive high windows. -/
    59	noncomputable def Scheme.highWindowMulKoszulBoundary
    60	    (N S D : X.CurveDivisor) (n : ℕ)
    61	    (b : Module.Basis ι K ↑(divisorSections K S ⊤)) :
    62	    (ι × ι → ↑(divisorSections K (N + n • S - D) ⊤)) →ₗ[K]
    63	      (ι → ↑(divisorSections K (N + (n + 1) • S - D) ⊤)) :=
    64	  Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary
    65	    (divisorSections K S ⊤)
    66	    (divisorSections K (N + n • S - D) ⊤)
    67	    (divisorSections K (N + (n + 1) • S - D) ⊤) b
    68	    (fun i z => Scheme.mul_mem_divisorSections_highWindow N S D n (b i) z)
    69	
    70	/-- A basepoint-free pair in the multiplier window gives the complete
    71	field-level relation theorem at every high-window stage. -/
    72	theorem Scheme.ker_finiteMulMap_eq_range_highWindowMulKoszulBoundary_of_pair
    73	    (g : ℕ) (N S D : X.CurveDivisor) (β : ℤ)
    74	    (hvan : ∀ W : X.CurveDivisor, β ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K W →
    75	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K W) 1))
    76	    (hSdeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K S)
    77	    (hβN : β + 2 * (g : ℤ) + CurveDivisor.deg K S ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K N)
    78	    (hDdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K D = (g : ℤ)) (n : ℕ)
    79	    (b : Module.Basis ι K ↑(divisorSections K S ⊤))
    80	    (v0 v1 : X.functionFieldˣ)
    81	    (hv0 : (v0 : X.functionField) ∈ divisorSections K S ⊤)
    82	    (hv1 : (v1 : X.functionField) ∈ divisorSections K S ⊤)
    83	    (hbpf : (S + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊓
    84	      (S + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1) = 0) :
    85	    LinearMap.ker
    86	        (Scheme.finiteMulMap (divisorSections K S ⊤)
    87	          (divisorSections K (N + (n + 1) • S - D) ⊤) b) =
    88	      LinearMap.range (Scheme.highWindowMulKoszulBoundary N S D n b) := by
    89	  have hA : N + (n + 1) • S - D = (N + n • S - D) + S := by
    90	    rw [add_nsmul, one_nsmul]
    91	    abel_nf
    92	  have hlat := divisor_pencil_lattice_of_basepointFree
    93	    (A := N + (n + 1) • S - D) (B := N + n • S - D) S v0 v1 hA hbpf
    94	  have hH := highWindow_pencil_h1 g N S D β hvan hSdeg hβN hDdeg n v0 v1 hbpf
    95	  have hexact :=
    96	    Scheme.ker_finiteMulMap_eq_range_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_of_divisor_pair
    97	      (divisorSections K S ⊤) b
    98	      (N + (n + 1) • S - D) (N + n • S - D) v0 v1 hv0 hv1
    99	      (fun i z => Scheme.mul_mem_divisorSections_highWindow N S D n (b i) z)
   100	      hlat.1 hlat.2 hH.2.1 hH.2.2.1 hH.2.2.2.1 hH.2.2.2.2
   101	  simpa only [Scheme.highWindowMulKoszulBoundary] using hexact
